profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer at Q2
profile.summary:
Accomplished Staff Software Engineer and technical leader with 20+ years of experience designing and building backend integration systems. Specializes in Go, with additional experience in .NET Core, and deep expertise in distributed systems, REST services, and financial technology platforms. Primarily works in macOS and Linux environments. 

Proven track record leading cross-functional teams, mentoring engineers, and driving large-scale system modernization efforts. Incorporates AI-assisted development using Claude (Anthropic) and Claude Code CLI to accelerate delivery, improve code quality, and author custom agent skills and automation workflows. Thrives in remote environments; consistently delivers reliable, maintainable solutions at scale.

Languages: Go, C#/.NET Core, .NET Framework, SQL, T-SQL
Development: Backend Architecture, System Integration, API Design, Microservices, Data Access
Technologies: REST Services, Protocol Buffers, Microservice Integration
Databases: Microsoft SQL Server 2008 R2+, Oracle
Tools & IDEs: GoLand, Rider, Visual Studio
Version Control: Git, GitLab, GitHub, TFS
Operating Systems: macOS, Linux, Windows

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
Q2 provides a cloud-based mobile banking platform and technology solutions to over 22 million end users across 1,300 financial institutions and fintech clients globally.

•  Led the conversion of legacy .NET adapter code to Go; adapters are integration components connecting internal Q2 systems to remote financial institution cores — a high-visibility modernization initiative.

•  Provided technical leadership and mentorship to junior developers and an offshore development team, managing day-to-day task completion and technical direction.

•  Assisted Development Manager with daily operations: facilitated stand-up meetings, managed team goals and sprint tasks, and participated in candidate interviews.

•  Led design, development, testing, and maintenance of software applications; held responsibility for architecture decisions and technical standard-setting across the team.

•  Identified and resolved performance bottlenecks, optimizing critical code paths and integration throughput for improved speed and system efficiency.

•  Collaborated cross-functionally with product managers, designers, and QA to deliver features meeting business requirements on schedule.

•  Maintained ongoing production support: addressed bugs, resolved incidents, and systematically reduced technical debt in legacy adapter code.
positions.insights: Skills: .NET · .NET Framework · Web Services · Microsoft SQL Server · Software Development · Go (Programming Language) · C# · Windows Server · Integration · Mac · Coding Standards · Software Engineering Practices · Development Tools · Object-Oriented Programming (OOP)

positions.title: .Net Lead Software Development Engineer
positions.description:
•  Served as Project Team Lead overseeing architecture, development, and mentoring across project teams of 3–15 developers, plus QA, BA, and PM staff.

•  Designed and developed REST services, Windows Services, console applications, and WinForms applications — primarily integration-focused work in Data Warehouse, Cash Management, and Budgeting.

•  Served on the merger integration team for association bank mergers, overseeing all Windows-based applications and system integrations across merging entities.

•  Managed workloads for onsite FTEs and 3rd-party development vendors; reviewed and mentored contract developers; enforced architecture compliance with enterprise guidelines.

•  Handled day-to-day project assignments, FTE/contractor task delegation, and staff mentoring on architecture and technical problem-solving.

•  Core stack: C#, .NET Core, SQL Server, REST/WCF/ASMX, Windows Services, WinForms, RabbitMQ, TFS, Git, Azure DevOps CI/CD.
positions.insights: Skills: .NET · Web Services · Microsoft SQL Server · Software Development · Integration · Coding Standards · Software Engineering Practices · Development Tools · Object-Oriented Programming (OOP)

positions.title: Chief Information Officer
positions.description:
I entered this company after the owners had died and the company was left to the children. This position started out based on finding out how everything worked in the organization. Areas included the software assets, customer implementation process, networking and server assets, support functions for customers. Initially there was staff with some knowledge base but due to the circumstances they quickly left the company.

•  Conducted a comprehensive audit of software assets, customer implementation processes, networking/server infrastructure, and support operations to establish baseline understanding.

•  Rebuilt development, support, and implementation teams from the ground up after existing staff departed; restored customer implementations and active development to on-track status.

•  Navigated two CEO transitions, maintaining technical strategy and team stability under rapidly changing executive leadership — including under a CEO unfamiliar with the software industry.

•  Technical stack: C#, VB 6/.NET, SQL Server, Oracle, Windows Server, Active Directory, Exchange, SAN file servers.
positions.insights: Skills: .NET · Web Services · Microsoft SQL Server · Software Development · Coding Standards · Software Engineering Practices · Development Tools · Object-Oriented Programming (OOP)

positions.title: Engineering Team Lead
positions.description:
Affiniscape is a SaaS company that provides Association management software, content management, and job boards.  Several key projects have been worked on during this period including removal of all credit card API access in favor of a central framed in PCI compliant web site and gateway to a conversion of the job board application from VB to C#. All applications are multi-tenant and attention must be paid to code structure and data access for performance as well as cross client data restrictions.

•  Led the removal of direct credit card API access across all applications in favor of a centralized, PCI-compliant payment gateway — reducing compliance risk across the platform.

•  Led the rewrite of the job board application from VB to C#, improving maintainability and aligning it with the modern stack.

•  Implemented the AAA unit test design pattern across projects using nUnit, MS Test, and WatiN; raised overall test coverage and code quality standards.

•  Developed and refactored the ASP.NET web front-end, business layer (C#/LINQ), data access layer, and Windows Services.

•  Conducted code reviews, provided development estimates based on architectural designs, and managed day-to-day team needs including scheduling and candidate interviews.
positions.insights: Skills: .NET · Web Services · Microsoft SQL Server · Software Development · Integration · Coding Standards · Software Engineering Practices · Development Tools · Object-Oriented Programming (OOP)

positions.title: Senior Lead Consultant
positions.description:
•  Asuragen: Built a Microsoft Word Add-In (VB.NET, Signature Provider API) enabling digital document signing within a federally regulated business workflow.

•  Catapult Internal: Enhanced an internal expense reporting web application; modernized data access using Entity Framework (C#).

•  Field Asset Services – Project Lead: Led requirements gathering, staff assignments, and full SDLC for a large-scale web application consolidating a desktop app and website into a unified platform designed for 5–7 years of organizational growth. Built WCF service layer and LINQ/SQL 2005 data access tier (C#).

•  Zebra Imaging: Designed and deployed a custom web ordering portal allowing customers to upload hologram source files and place orders; built C# business and data tiers against SQL Server 2005.

•  Dell Latin America – Team Lead: Managed an upgrade of Dell's Latin American stores to the current global platform; coordinated with Dell management on scope, regional customization, and project planning (MS Project).

projects.title: Association Bank Mergers
projects.description: The project team of 40+ FCBT employees successfully supported the merger and acquisition of four Association Banks into two by providing the technology services and support to combine the business processes and application data of each entity. All technology services, infrastructure and business processes supported by FCBT were considered for analysis to determine impact and planning for the project.
